title: Spiced Tomato Lentil and Chickpea Soup
ingredients: large handful of parsley leaves, plus extra chopped to serve
1 red chilli, deseeded and finely chopped
400g (14oz) can of chickpeas, drained and rinsed
2 lemons, cut into wedges, to serve
SPICE MIX: 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp ground turmeric, 1 tsp ground ginger, 1/2 tsp ground cinnamon, 1/2 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp pepper
method: Make up the spice mix in a small bowl.
In a food processor, blend the onions and celery until very finely chopped.

In a large saucepan, heat the oil and scrape in the onion and celery. Fry gently for 10 minutes. Meanwhile, put the tomatoes, carrots, garlic, parsley and chilli in the food processor and blend until smooth.
Increase the heat, add the spice blend to the onions and stir for 30 seconds. Reduce heat and pour in the tomato mixture. Add the hot stock, red lentils, chickpeas, sweet potato and tomato purée.
Bring to the boil, then gently simmer for 45 minutes, stirring occasionally. Serve with lemon wedges and parsley.
notes: Leftover Fakeaway Doner Kebab (p.169) chopped up makes a delicious meaty addition. Coriander or mint leaves also work well.
